title: Twelve Winters and One Short Table
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：family　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 family 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my grandmother ① raised a family that no neighbour in the lane would have counted, and she said the raising was the whole of the winter. The ② family, meaning the household itself and not the house, ran twelve winters and stayed uncounted in the book; a family, she said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ family in that lane had the same short table beside it, and the ④ family at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the Sunday and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A family, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; my grandmother said the counting is the part that fills twelve winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the family was the whole of the name, meaning the line and not the household. The ⑥ family, meaning the line and not any of that, is the only thing in a name that everybody waits for and nobody counts; family, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both a household and a line. He said the line is the part they remember.

By 1956 the ⑦ family had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ family of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one lane and twelve winters of counting; family, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to count. She said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ family I remember is the one counted in the register, which closed in 1960 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ family, my mother said in 1962, is the only one that improves by being counted; every family, she said, is a line that has agreed to look like a household. She said the line was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家庭（指巷子里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 家庭（指那一户人家本身，与房子相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise a family 养活一家人
D. n. 家庭（指留给礼拜天的那一户）
E. n. 家庭（抽象总称，指一条巷子的持家之事）
F. n. 家庭（指登记簿上写到、被点数的那一户）
G. n. 家族；世系（指一个姓氏里人人都等却无人点数的那样东西）
H. n. 世系（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人点数的那样东西）

items.q: raised a family that no neighbour in the lane would have counted

answers.why: raise a family 意为“养活一家人”，1946 年祖母养活了一户巷子里没有一位邻居肯点数的人家。
family 意为“家庭”，指那一户人家本身而不是房子，它经过了十二个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
family 意为“家庭”，指巷子里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一张短短的桌子。
family 意为“家庭”，指留给礼拜天的那一户，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
family 意为“家族、世系”，指一个姓氏里人人都等却无人点数的那样东西，叔叔说这个世系就是那个姓氏的全部。
family 意为“世系”，指人人都等却无人点数的那样东西而不是那一户人家，是姓氏里人人都等、却无人点数的东西。
family 意为“家庭”，指登记簿上写到、被点数的那一户，到 1956 年这一户成了登记簿里的一行。
family 意为“家庭”，祖母一月写道，整件事的持家之事是一条巷子和十二个冬天的点数。
family 意为“家庭”，我记得的是登记簿上点数的那一户，1960 年结束了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一户。
family 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，一户人家是唯一会因为被好好点数而变得更好的东西。
